_about: The 12-note evaluation set for the clinical notes parser. Reconstructed 2026-09-23 from the case descriptions in docs/FEATURE_VERIFICATION.md section 3 -- the original notes.json lived in a session scratchpad that no longer exists. Each note reproduces the documented case (which fields it should yield, and the specific trap it was written to expose); the exact original wording is not recoverable and is not claimed.

notes.trap: typical angina must not be flattened to ASY
notes.text: 58-year-old male presenting with typical angina on exertion. Resting BP 152/94. Total cholesterol 268 mg/dl. Max heart rate 138 on treadmill. Exercise-induced angina present. ST depression 2.4 mm.

notes.trap: LDL must not be read as total cholesterol; a resting pulse must not be read as MaxHR
notes.text: 64-year-old male, atypical angina. BP 138/88. LDL 160 mg/dl, total cholesterol 230 mg/dl. Pulse 88 at rest. Fasting blood sugar above 120.

notes.trap: 'Denies chest pain' must not yield a chest pain type; 'HR 72 at rest' must not become MaxHR
notes.text: 41-year-old male, non-smoker. Denies chest pain. BP 118/76. Total cholesterol 185 mg/dl. HR 72 at rest.

notes.trap: pure Arabic -- must be reported as unsupported, not as an empty note
notes.text: مريض ذكر عمره 58 سنة، يشكو من ألم في الصدر عند المجهود. ضغط الدم 150/95. الكوليسترول الكلي 260.

notes.trap: mixed script -- English abbreviations parse, Arabic does not; must be flagged as partial
notes.text: مريض ذكر، BP 150/95، total cholesterol 260 mg/dl، لا يوجد تدخين. FBS > 120.

notes.trap: pure Arabic, no Latin digits context -- must be reported as unsupported
notes.text: المريضة أنثى، تعاني من ارتفاع ضغط الدم وألم صدري غير نمطي. لا تاريخ عائلي لأمراض القلب.

notes.trap: affirmative history terms should map to 1
notes.text: 52-year-old female. Known hypertension and high cholesterol. BMI 33.4. Current smoker. Previous myocardial infarction. Rates her general health as fair.

notes.trap: the negation case -- every one of these must be 0, not 1
notes.text: 47-year-old male, non-smoker. No history of hypertension. Denies stroke, no heart disease. BMI 26.1. Cholesterol checked last year.

notes.trap: BRFSS age bucket must come from the stated age
notes.text: 42-year-old female with hypertension and hyperlipidaemia. BMI 31.0. History of stroke. Physically active most weeks.

notes.trap: pure Arabic -- must be reported as unsupported
notes.text: مريضة عمرها 52 سنة، لديها ارتفاع في ضغط الدم والكوليسترول. مؤشر كتلة الجسم 33. مدخّنة.

notes.trap: mixed script -- only BMI / BP style tokens parse
notes.text: مريض عمره 47 سنة، BMI 26، BP مرتفع، لا يمارس الرياضة. GenHlth fair.

notes.trap: pure Arabic -- must be reported as unsupported
notes.text: المريض يعاني من السمنة وقلة النشاط البدني، ولا يوجد تاريخ للجلطة أو أمراض القلب.
